findings.title: Sensitive File Exposure - Flag in /tmp/flag
findings.description: The CTF challenge container exposed a flag file at /tmp/flag containing a UUID-formatted flag. The file was accessible via direct container access, indicating insufficient file permissions or exposure of sensitive files in temporary directories.
